topline.text: The morning after: Chancellor John Healey's first Budget landed yesterday with little new money specifically for schools, and the OBR's forecast flags a widening SEND funding gap - full DfE detail is still to follow.
Treat any school-funding figures doing the rounds today as provisional until the Department for Education publishes its own breakdown of the settlement.
Genuinely quiet locally too - Sheffield schools stay closed for half term until Monday 2 November, so no new city-level stories broke in the last 24 hours.
Reminder: the NEU's formal strike ballot over pay, funding and workload is still open and closes 15 December.

diary.text: Sheffield schools' autumn half term continues.
First Schools Budget Support Grant 2026 payments due to go out to local authorities.
NEU's formal strike ballot over pay, funding and workload closes.
UK City of Culture 2029 winner announced; Sheffield is one of four finalists.

items.body: Chancellor John Healey's first Budget, delivered yesterday alongside the OBR's updated forecast, included few new schools-specific announcements. The OBR's figures point to councils' cumulative SEND deficits continuing to widen sharply over the next couple of years - treat the exact scale as a reported, not independently verified, figure until DfE's own breakdown lands. Commentary also flagged that mainstream per-pupil funding is on track to fall in real terms, as funding is held flat against falling pupil numbers, with no new grant confirmed to cover schools' rising minimum-wage costs.
items.action: Hold off on budget-planning assumptions until the DfE publishes its own schools-funding breakdown of yesterday's settlement.

items.body: Education Secretary Lucy Powell inherits a department where SEND cost pressures remain the dominant budget issue for schools and councils alike; expect more detail on how the Budget settlement feeds into the wider SEND reform programme in the coming weeks rather than today.

Sheffield schools remain closed for the autumn half term until Monday 2 November. Academies can set their own dates, so it's worth double-checking individual school calendars before assuming a city-wide return.

box.text: The OBR's forecast for English councils' cumulative SEND overspend by 2027-28, cited in Budget coverage - a directional figure to watch rather than a confirmed exact one.
